text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Lake, Thunder, Mountain... no, Wind!
Our path forward lies to the southeast!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can see the path, my doubts disappear!
No matter what formidable opponent stands before me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Yes, yes! Did you see that?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is my running!♪ Even if my opponent is Senior Class,
I won't back down a single step!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A commanding run. Copano Rickey demonstrated her young talent on the grand stage of the Central dirt GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was that?
Wasn't that my best run of the whole year?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was overflowing with good luck!
Yeah, it was overflowing with good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? ☆ Today felt like
the waves of sand were giving me a push from behind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, at this rate, next year will be even better!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae! And Acute-san too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute,
who had run alongside each other, came over.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today☆
Maybe because both of our fortunes were in perfect harmony,
I felt a fiery passion burning within!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, how was my run?
Do you think I'll be able to keep going strong next year too?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ricky's running was...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can manage.
I think we can make it work. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Such a waste... right...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, you think it's a waste?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chan, what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae's eyes brimmed with an unbearable heartache.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I worked hard... worked so, so hard,
and finally, I can run like I do now...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was keeping my feet firmly on the ground in my own way.
But Rickey... was a bit different, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've spent so much time on things
that didn't seem directly related to racing...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "So, while it's amazing you can run this far, I really wanted you to value your own personal time more!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "If she put as much hard work into training as she did into obsessing over feng shui, she could run so much better! She has the talent for it!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you just took it seriously... If you took it seriously,
you're amazing enough to make anything come true!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to race against Rickey giving it her all,
through and through...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tar... mae...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those words were like a raging wave. Mixed into that cute voice was a faint hint of fury.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae-chan, don't be so mad~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... No, that's not it! It's not like
I was just goofing off, either...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Well, it's true I ended up on TV a ton along the way and almost got crushed by overexposure, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Still, in my own way...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae didn't answer.
She just stood there, biting her lip in frustration.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them fell silent.
As even Wonder Acute stood there at a loss for words—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, you two. That's enough☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"You can't do that, not right after
such a fun race."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An Umadol especially has to make sure never to forget her smile. Right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's just, I really can't get behind feng shui and stuff...
Because things like that couldn't save anyone back then...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae gave a slight bow and walked away.
I knew full well she meant no harm.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I really don't think it's weird.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to make everyone happy with feng shui.
All the Umamusume, and Tarumae too. That's why!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Do they not see it that way, though?
Does it just look like I'm goofing around?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand how both of them feel.
However—
choice_data_list: I'm sure your dream is just a little too big.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Too big? My dream is?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. After all, Tarumae-chan is the kind of Umamusume who works hard for those close to her.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So maybe the whole "making everyone happy with feng shui" thing just doesn't really click with people, you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Despite how she looks, she's been through a lot.
She's seen the local circuits where relying on luck won't get you anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: B-But still... you say it's a detour, but Tarumae-chan practices singing and dancing as an Umadol too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I think they'll understand little by little.
Don't worry about it, Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. I was able to show running that could match Tarumae and the others today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I probably couldn't show any feelings that truly resonated, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This isn't what I was aiming for today. Not something like this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae's love for her hometown. My desire to help people through feng shui. Putting our precious feelings into our running and clashing against each other—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wanted us to compete, acknowledge each other, and build a circle.
That was the kind of challenge I wanted to take on.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to try again!
To do what I couldn't do today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Then where should I go?
Where is the next race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A race that seems tailor-made for Hokko Tarumae to target next would be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, one of the two major JRA Dirt GⅠ races came to a close.
Which means, the other one is—
choice_data_list: That would be the February Stakes in February.
It'd probably be the February Stakes in February, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes.
A race just as grand as today's...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, over there then!
Let's do that one next!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need to check with feng shui?
Don't you need to check with feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. Good fortune or bad, I want to run.
Because I have to.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"So this time, I really want Tarumae to understand!
I know she can understand!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey said, as if encouraging herself.
It sounded almost like she was convincing herself for the sake of the February Stakes.
